description: This file contains a series of shell script tests and utility functions for testing the behavior of Git's repack command, especially regarding cruft handling, pack size limits, and pack index management.

methods.name: generate_random_blob
methods.description: Generates a random data blob, writes it as a Git object, and removes the temporary file.

methods.name: pack_random_blob
methods.description: Generates a random blob and runs git repack to include it.

methods.name: generate_cruft_pack
methods.description: Creates a pack with a random blob and returns the path to its mtimes file.

methods.name: find_pack
methods.description: Finds pack index files containing a specific object by searching index files.

methods.name: setup_cruft_exclude_tests
methods.description: Sets up repository states for testing cruft pack exclusion or inclusion in pack indices.
